# list_tracks { #geneinfo.ucsc.list_tracks }

```python
geneinfo.ucsc.list_tracks(assembly, *, label_wrap=80)
```

Print all tracks for an assembly (including flattened subtracks).

Same as :func:`search_tracks` without queries.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**assembly**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Genome assembly, e.g. ``'hg38'``.

<code>[**label_wrap**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [80]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Width at which each track's long label is wrapped.
